issue.title: Remove global bazelrc from Bazel distribution packages

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
After a lot of discussion, we've decided that the existing global bazelrc file (https://source.bazel.build/bazel/+/369409995bd75eeb0683fd24f7585d2a90320796:scripts/packages/bazel.bazelrc) is not helpful for both general users, and is causing issues with remote execution in many cases.

See #4475 for an example. This will probably impact #4502 .

The best solution is to remove the global bazelrc entirely. Bazel will continue to set a default PATH of "/bin:/usr/bin" on non-Windows systems where PATH isn't specified via `--actions_env`.

body: Thank you for the bug report. I'll get a fix out ASAP.
